references.text: The same introductory formula is used here where the Lord speaks to Moses and introduces instructions about offerings.
The Lord speaks to Moses in the same way and gives him instructions for the people.
An identical introductory formula where the Lord reveals his word to Moses.
The same wording is used to introduce further instructions about the sin offering.
The Lord again speaks to Moses with the same introduction and continues with the laws concerning offerings.
The Lord speaks to Moses and confirms his covenant and his name YHWH.
God spoke in ancient times to the fathers through the prophets, including Moses, but has now spoken through the Son.
